commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

sessionId.description: A session's id: a UUID the creating client mints (never the provider's resume id), kept in lowercase.

anyOf.description: A title a user gives a session: 1 to 200 characters, not all white space; stored trimmed.

title.description: The new title, or null to revert to the generated title or the default.
